capabilities: Generate UUID, NanoID, ULID, or Snowflake UIDs into note frontmatter
Automatically assign UIDs to new notes in scoped folders
Scan the vault for duplicate UIDs and resolve them
Copy UIDs or title+UID text in customizable formats
Clear UIDs from all notes in a folder
extras: README warns that the multi-file context menu relies on an undocumented Obsidian event (files-menu) that could break in future updates, and that bulk UID clearing is irreversible with a confirmation modal.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to give notes stable unique identifiers in frontmatter for linking, scripting, or external systems, or to catch duplicate IDs introduced by copies and templates.
summary: Unique ID manager that generates UUID, NanoID, ULID, or Snowflake identifiers into note frontmatter, with auto-assignment, duplicate detection, and copy/bulk tools.
